pattern: Agent-advised relaxation of the Rigor Framework produced substrate + tracking surfaces while the core deliverable (a followable health plan) was never wired end-to-end.
promised_mitigation: Re-instate core-deliverable-first discipline (a session-level core-capability-works-end-to-end gate before secondary work); treat an agent recommendation to loosen a known-failure-class guard as a red flag requiring informed sign-off; build the plan-generation path.

pattern: A dispatched review/triage agent granted Bash(git:*) left the repo checked out on main; the orchestrator nearly resumed branch-dependent work against the wrong tree.
promised_mitigation: Post-dispatch git-branch re-verify; constrain review/triage/verify agents to non-mutating git (no checkout/switch/stash/reset).

pattern: Produced plan-generation screen designs solo with thin/guessed content (~15% of the fields the specialists require) instead of orchestrating the design agent team + the operator-profile.md/goals.md authoritative schemas; presented as a finished surface.
promised_mitigation: Design direction/mockup/critique orchestrated through the design agent team + authoritative schemas; orchestrator studies inputs but does not originate the design. Guard before any design artifact.

pattern: Routed bounded iterative design changes (change the top, remove sparklines, port a card) through full-rebuild agents, which regressed explicitly-removed elements (sparklines reappeared), added defects (empty banner, placeholder highlight), drifted from the bounded ask, and stalled — making every change a fight and preventing the layout from converging.
promised_mitigation: Bounded edits to an existing artifact are made by hand in place — smallest change only, nothing else touched; reserve agents for from-scratch origination, never for tweaks. Classify every change edit-vs-origination first.

pattern: Presented the instrument dashboard re-skin to the operator without first running the design-critic gate (operator surfaced the shallow re-skin the critic later confirmed: chrome re-skinned but data-viz/blue-gradients/figure left in the old palette); and rationalized the elliptical Readiness gauges as a get_screenshot aspect artifact instead of a controlled probe, presenting the unverified defect twice before diagnosing the real cause (Pencil rotates rects about the top-left corner; fix rotation=360-theta).
promised_mitigation: Design-critic runs BEFORE presenting any design artifact to the operator (ui-designer->design-critic handoff is part of using the team; if skipped, state why). Before attributing a visual defect to the tool, prove it with a controlled probe (isolate a known-good primitive).
